description: This Java source file defines the interface DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder, which provides nested interfaces for building command responses and events related to deleting features within a live command processing framework in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies factories for creating response objects (including errors) and events like FeatureDeleted, used in handling delete feature commands.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Main interface providing nested factory interfaces for building responses and events related to deleting features within a live command framework.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating response objects for delete feature commands, including success responses and various error responses.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by delete feature commands, such as FeatureDeleted.
